runtime.title: Google Search Console analytics and website search evidence
notes: Adds the explicitly enabled Search Console connection in Settings and search reports in Analytics, with read-only Google OAuth by default, optional sitemap management, encrypted offline credentials, browser-bound single-use authorization and revision-fenced property selection and disconnection.

Adds Pacific-time search performance types, dimensions, filters and pagination, durable bounded report snapshots, scheduled report refresh, exact-website URL inspection and sitemap status/submission. Domain-property queries are constrained to the installation website origin; Google quotas, partial data, query anonymity, unavailable reports and pagination limits remain visible.

Adds migration 0012, a separate search-console:manage capability, setup and agent-care guidance, website verification handoff, fixture coverage and packed-consumer checks. Existing installations are not enabled, connected, deployed or migrated automatically.

Adds authenticated owner-managed Google application setup, OAuth Web client JSON import, write-only encrypted client secrets, exact callback guidance and application revision fencing. Adds a dedicated Search Console cron companion for existing Cloudflare Pages installations without changing their hosting, mail, billing or other schedulers.

contracts.title: Typed Google search reports and scoped connection management
notes: Adds Search Console query/report/status types, supported search dimensions and types, provenance, Pacific timezone, Google partial-data metadata, pagination and source-limit disclosures.

Adds search-console:manage to owner and administrator role defaults, retains analyst read-only access through analytics:read, and identifies the optional connection separately from business navigation.
Adds the redacted owner application-settings response for in-admin OAuth setup, including revision, callback URL, credential presence and configuration source.

initializer.title: Initialize with the Search Console capable runtime
notes: Updates the initializer version and pins runtime 1.7.0. This is a version/dependency-only initializer change; new installations receive the runtime and agent guidance while Search Console remains disabled until explicitly configured and authorized.
